verdict.rationale: Codegen's SDK and API allow programmatic creation and management of multiple agents (e.g., looping agent.run calls, listing/filtering agent runs, triggering from CI/CD), which enables scripted bulk operations across many tasks/repos. However, there is no explicit bulk/batch endpoint or documented at-scale example. Missing for 10: a native bulk-operation API/endpoint, documented examples of running operations across many items simultaneously, and evidence of scale/performance under bulk use.
